scenes.text: Here's America's receipt for Cyber Week, last year.
Black Friday, online: eleven point eight billion.
Cyber Monday: fourteen point two five billion. The biggest online shopping day ever.
The other three days: eighteen billion more.
Total? Forty-four point two billion dollars. In five days.
And over one billion of Cyber Monday was buy now, pay later.
This year's receipt prints next week. Guess the total in the comments.
